summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` (~727 KB, header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) is a heavily obfuscated Bun bundle: string-array rotation function `WV8StW`, a large numeric character table `n7gIxM`, a custom base64-like decoder `hc1jfK9`, and hex-named identifiers, making the executed content opaque to Node-based tooling. The advertised surface is a bare re-export shim (`dist/index.mjs` lists `export const X = globalThis['VueDemi'].X` entries) mimicking the vue-demi library, while the only substantive install-time behavior is fetching an unrelated language runtime purely to execute the obfuscated bundled payload on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The scoped name `@onereach/orest-vue-demi-vue2` resembles the vue-demi project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
